slides.title: Memoization Pattern Logic
slides.prompt: What data structure is typically used inside a memoization closure decorator to cache results?
options: A dictionary mapping argument tuples to computed return values
An ordered list of string outputs
A temporary binary file on disk
slides.correctAnswer: A dictionary mapping argument tuples to computed return values

slides.title: Retry Decorator Delay
slides.prompt: Fill in the module function used to pause execution between retries inside a retry decorator.
slides.codeSnippet:
import time
# inside retry loop
time.___(delay_seconds)

slides.title: Route Decorator Pattern in Web Frameworks
slides.prompt: How do web frameworks like Flask or FastAPI use decorators like `@app.route('/api')`?
options: To register the decorated view function into an internal URL routing table mapping
To compile Python functions into C extensions
To execute the function repeatedly on every HTTP request concurrently
To encrypt HTTP response body data automatically
slides.correctAnswer: To register the decorated view function into an internal URL routing table mapping
